claims.statement: Keibu Keioiba is a tiger-headed, human-bodied creature of Meitei mythology and folklore in Manipur.
claims.statement_id: Keibu Keioiba adalah makhluk berkepala harimau dan bertubuh manusia dalam mitologi dan cerita rakyat Meitei di Manipur.
claims.quote: Keibu Keioiba, also known as Kabui Keioiba, is a mythical creature with the head of a tiger and the body of a human in the Meitei mythology and folklore of Manipur. According to legend, he was once a skilful priest named Kabui Salang Maiba. He used witchcraft to turn himself into a ferocious tiger. As punishment of his pride, he could not completely turn back to his original human form.

claims.statement: Legend describes him as the priest Kabui Salang Maiba who used witchcraft to become a tiger.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, ia dahulu pendeta Kabui Salang Maiba yang menggunakan sihir untuk berubah menjadi harimau.
claims.quote: According to legend, he was once a skilful priest named Kabui Salang Maiba. He used witchcraft to turn himself into a ferocious tiger.

claims.statement: In the tale an old woman directs the creature to Thabaton, who is home alone.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisahnya, seorang perempuan tua mengarahkan makhluk itu kepada Thabaton yang tinggal sendirian.
claims.quote: Keibu Keioiba was a human in the daytime and a tiger at night. During night, he prowled around looking for food. One night, he found an older woman's house and planned to devour her. The old woman said that her wrinkled skin would not be tasty and suggested that he eat a beautiful and young woman named Thabaton instead. Thabaton was the only sister in a family with seven brothers.

claims.statement: He takes Thabaton to the forest and forces her to become his wife.
claims.statement_id: Ia membawa Thabaton ke hutan dan memaksanya menjadi istrinya.
claims.quote: Keibu Keioiba has not eaten Thabaton. Instead, he has forced Thabaton to become his wife, and they live together in the forest.

claims.statement: Thabaton sends him to fetch water with a pipe open at both ends so she can escape with her brothers.
claims.statement_id: Thabaton menyuruhnya mengambil air dengan pipa terbuka di kedua ujung agar dapat melarikan diri bersama saudara-saudaranya.
claims.quote: Thabaton gives him a hollow utong (bamboo pipe) open at both ends. She tells Keibu Keioiba to fetch water from the stream with the utong.

claims.statement: In the translation of Jayantakumar Sharma's tale Keibu Keioiba is human by day and a tiger at night.
claims.statement_id: Dalam terjemahan cerita Jayantakumar Sharma, Keibu Keioiba menjadi manusia pada siang hari dan harimau pada malam hari.
claims.quote: there lived a man called Keibu Keioiba who was human in daytime and during night he would turn into a tiger.

claims.statement: Macchanu is Hanuman's son in the Thai and other versions of the Ramayana.
claims.statement_id: Macchanu adalah putra Hanuman dalam versi Thailand dan versi lain Ramayana.
claims.quote:
Macchanu (Thai: มัจฉานุ; RTGS: Matchanu; Khmer: មច្ឆានុប; RTGS: Macchanub) is the son of Hanuman that appears in the 
Thai version of the story and other versions of the Ramayana.

claims.statement: He is described as having a vanara upper body and a fish tail.
claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan bertubuh atas vanara dan berekor ikan.
claims.quote: who looked like vanara from waist-up but had tail of a fish.

claims.statement: Akashvani reveals that the enemy Hanuman is about to harm is his own son by Suvannamaccha.
claims.statement_id: Suara Akashvani mengungkapkan bahwa musuh yang hendak diserang Hanuman adalah putranya dari Suvannamaccha.
claims.quote: reveals by way of Akashvani that the enemy, whom he is going to harm is his own son born by his union with Suvannamaccha, the mermaid daughter of Ravana.

claims.statement: In another version he guards a pond on Hanuman's journey to find Rama and Laxmana.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi lain, ia menjaga kolam pada perjalanan Hanuman mencari Rama dan Laxmana.
claims.quote: while following Maiyarap in order to find Rama and Laxmana, who have been abducted by Maiyarap and taken to his kingdom in netherworld, Hanuman reaches a pond, where he encounters Macchanu.

claims.statement: He names Maiyarap as his foster father and gives a riddle about the entrance through a lotus.
claims.statement_id: Ia menyebut Maiyarap sebagai ayah angkat, lalu memberi petunjuk teka-teki tentang jalan masuk melalui teratai.
claims.quote: He tells Hanuman that Maiyarap is his foster father, ... tells Hanuman through a riddle the entrance to the netherworld lies inside the lotus in the pond he was guarding.

claims.statement: Thailand Foundation describes Macchanu as raised by Maiyarap and assigned to guard the netherworld entrance.
claims.statement_id: Thailand Foundation menyebut Macchanu dibesarkan Maiyarap dan ditugaskan menjaga jalan masuk dunia bawah.
claims.quote: Macchanu was raised by Maiyarap (Ahiravan), the demon king of the netherworld, and tasked with guarding its entrance.

claims.statement: Mahishi is a demoness in Hindu mythology whose story concerns Ayyappa and Sabarimala.
claims.statement_id: Mahishi adalah sosok iblis perempuan dalam mitologi Hindu yang kisahnya berkaitan dengan Ayyappa dan Sabarimala.
claims.quote: In Hindu mythology, Mahishi is a powerful demoness whose narrative is central to the origin of Lord Ayyappa and the traditions of the Sabarimala temple. She was the sister of the buffalo-demon Mahishasura.

claims.statement: This source calls her the sister of the buffalo demon Mahishasura.
claims.statement_id: Sumber ini menyebutnya saudari Mahishasura, iblis berwujud kerbau.
claims.quote: In Hindu mythology, Mahishi is a powerful demoness whose narrative is central to the origin of Lord Ayyappa and the traditions of the Sabarimala temple. She was the sister of the buffalo-demon Mahishasura.

claims.statement: She receives a boon that only a child of Shiva and Vishnu's union can kill her.
claims.statement_id: Ia menerima anugerah bahwa hanya anak dari persatuan Shiva dan Vishnu yang dapat membunuhnya.
claims.quote: From Brahma, she secured a specific boon: that she could only be slain by a child born of the union of Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu. Believing such a birth to be biologically impossible, she unleashed a reign of terror, conquering the Svarga and ousting Indra from his throne.

claims.statement: Ayyappan's birth satisfies that condition through Shiva's union with Mohini, Vishnu's female manifestation.
claims.statement_id: Kisah kelahiran Ayyappan menjawab syarat anugerah itu melalui persatuan Shiva dengan Mohini, penjelmaan perempuan Vishnu.
claims.quote: To counter Mahishi's invincibility, the deities sought a solution. Following the Samudra Manthana , Shiva was captivated by the beauty of Mohini, the female avatar of Vishnu. Their union led to the birth of Ayyappan (also known as Manikandan or Dharma Sastha), the divine child born of two male deities, thereby fulfilling the technical requirements of Mahishi’s boon.

claims.statement: Ayyappan seizes her horns and casts her to Earth during their battle.
claims.statement_id: Ayyappan menangkap tanduknya dan menjatuhkannya ke bumi dalam pertarungan.
claims.quote: When Mahishi attempted to storm heaven once more, Ayyappan, then a young prince, ascended to the celestial realms. He engaged the demoness in a fierce battle, eventually catching her by her horns and hurling her down to Earth. She landed on the banks of the Azhuthayar River near Sabarimala, where Ayyappan performed a divine dance on her body as she died.

claims.statement: Kerala Tourism explains Ayyappa's birth mission as eliminating the threat posed by Mahishi.
claims.statement_id: Kerala Tourism menjelaskan bahwa misi kelahiran Ayyappa adalah menghapus ancaman Mahishi.
claims.quote: The birth mission of Ayyappa was to eliminate the threat caused by Mahishi, a demoness.

claims.statement_id: Naga memiliki peran dalam cerita, sastra, mitologi, dan agama Meitei di Manipur.
claims.quote: Dragons play a significant role in the legendary accounts of Meitei folklore, literature, mythology and religion of ancient, medieval and modern Manipur.

claims.statement: Khelchandra Singh describes Pakhangba as the god king of Manipur in local belief.
claims.statement_id: Khelchandra Singh menggambarkan Pakhangba sebagai raja-dewa Manipur dalam kepercayaan setempat.
claims.quote: historical records have rendered a credulous halo to glorify Pakhangba as a God-king of Manipur

claims.statement: In that account he can move as a dragon at night.
claims.statement_id: Dalam penuturan itu, ia dapat bergerak sebagai naga pada malam hari.
claims.quote: Because of his divine power to be able to move about at night as dragon he is also known as Sanahing Pakhangba.

claims.statement: Manipur's kings use the dragon image as royal insignia.
claims.statement_id: Raja-raja Manipur menggunakan citra naga sebagai lambang kerajaan.
claims.quote: And all Rajas of Manipur have since used the dragon ... to represent the royal insignia.

claims.statement: Munjya are ghosts of boys who, in Maharashtra and Konkan folklore, died after the sacred-thread ceremony but before marriage.
claims.statement_id: Munjya adalah hantu anak laki-laki yang menurut cerita rakyat Maharashtra dan pesisir Konkan meninggal setelah upacara benang suci tetapi sebelum menikah.
claims.quote: According to folklore in Maharashtra and the Konkan coast, Munjya is believed to be the ghosts of boys who died after this ceremony but before marriage, inhabiting peepal trees.

claims.statement: They are believed to inhabit peepal trees.
claims.statement_id: Mereka dipercaya menghuni pohon peepal.
claims.quote: Munjya is believed to be the ghosts of boys who died after this ceremony but before marriage, inhabiting peepal trees.

claims.statement: Some tales describe restless bachelor ghosts with cleverness and multilingual abilities.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian cerita menggambarkan hantu bujang yang gelisah, cerdik, dan menguasai beberapa bahasa.
claims.quote: Munjya's are described as restless bachelor ghosts who roam trees at night, possessing cleverness and multilingual abilities.

claims.statement: Although usually harmless, they may retaliate against people who defile their tree homes.
claims.statement_id: Meskipun umumnya tidak berbahaya, mereka dapat membalas orang yang mengotori pohon tempat tinggalnya.
claims.quote: While most Munjya's are not harmful, they may retaliate against those who defile their tree homes, potentially pelting offenders with stones or causing accidents.

claims.statement: Some tales describe stone throwing or accidents as retaliation.
claims.statement_id: Cerita tertentu menyebut pelemparan batu atau kecelakaan sebagai bentuk pembalasan.
claims.quote: While most Munjya's are not harmful, they may retaliate against those who defile their tree homes, potentially pelting offenders with stones or causing accidents.

claims.statement: The filmmakers adapt Konkan coastal folklore into the horror comedy Munjya.
claims.statement_id: Para pembuat film mengadaptasi cerita rakyat pesisir Konkan menjadi komedi horor Munjya.
claims.quote: Writer Niren Bhatt and director-writer Amar Kaushik, who made Stree 2 and Bhediya, decided to fashion a folklore into a classic horror comedy—a medium they ace. And thus, Munjya came into being.

claims.statement: Poubi Lai is a dragon python of Meitei mythology and folklore dwelling in Manipur's Loktak Lake.
claims.statement_id: Poubi Lai adalah naga piton dalam mitologi dan cerita rakyat Meitei yang menghuni Danau Loktak di Manipur.
claims.quote: Poubi Lai was an ancient dragon python, who dwelled in the Loktak Lake of Manipur, in Meitei mythology and folklore. It is also referred to as "Loch Ness Monster of Manipur".

claims.statement: In one tale fishing by Moirang's fishermen angers it and it threatens the kingdom.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu kisah, ia marah akibat kegiatan nelayan Moirang dan mengancam kerajaan.
claims.quote: In the Loktak lake, the spirit of Poubi Lai was awakened by the fishing activities of the fishermen of Moirang. Being angered, Poubi Lai destroyed many human habitats and killed many people.

claims.statement: It demands a basket of rice and a human each day from Moirang's king.
claims.statement_id: Ia menuntut satu keranjang beras dan satu manusia setiap hari dari raja Moirang.
claims.quote: He threatened the King of Ancient Moirang to offer him one Shangbai (basket) of rice and one human every day.

claims.statement: Another version locates it at Karang Hill and describes it preying on fishermen.
claims.statement_id: Versi lain menempatkannya di Karang Hill dan menggambarkannya memangsa nelayan.
claims.quote: In another version of the story, Poubi Lai (Paobirai) lives in the isle of the Karang Hill in the Loktak lake. It hunted the fishermen of Moirang coming to the lake and devoured them. It even attacked human settlement and hunted for its prey.

claims.statement: The source records Poubi Lai in the Meitei manuscript Khongul Lirakpa.
claims.statement_id: Sumber menyebut Poubi Lai dalam naskah Meitei Khongul Lirakpa.
claims.quote: Poubi Lai (Paobirai) is mentioned in the ancient Meitei manuscript called the "Khongul Lirakpa".

claims.statement: Buru is a crocodilelike aquatic creature in the Apatani foundation myth of Arunachal Pradesh.
claims.statement_id: Buru adalah makhluk air mirip buaya dalam mitos asal-usul masyarakat Apatani di Arunachal Pradesh.
claims.quote: The buru or bura is an aquatic cryptic animal featured in a foundation myth of the Apatani people. Stories of the migration of the Apatani to their present location in the Ziro Valley of Arunachal Pradesh tell of a swamp occupying the valley, inhabited by fierce, crocodile-like creatures.

claims.statement: Migration stories place it in the Ziro Valley swamp before the land was drained for rice fields.
claims.statement_id: Kisah migrasi menempatkannya di rawa Lembah Ziro sebelum kawasan itu dikeringkan untuk sawah.
claims.quote: The buru or bura is an aquatic cryptic animal featured in a foundation myth of the Apatani people. Stories of the migration of the Apatani to their present location in the Ziro Valley of Arunachal Pradesh tell of a swamp occupying the valley, inhabited by fierce, crocodile-like creatures.

claims.statement: Mills and Stonor collected buru accounts from Apatani people in 1945 and 1946.
claims.statement_id: Mills dan Stonor mengumpulkan cerita tentang buru dari masyarakat Apatani pada 1945 dan 1946.
claims.quote: In 1945 and 1946, James Philip Mills and Charles Stonor gathered details about the buru from the Apatani people. According to the Apatani elders, when their forefathers migrated to Ziro Valley, the valley was primarily a marsh which was populated by burus. The Apatani people decided to settle in the valley because of its fertility and good climate.

claims.statement: Apatani elders recount that draining the wetlands killed most burus while some went underground into springs.
claims.statement_id: Tetua Apatani menuturkan bahwa pengeringan rawa menghilangkan sebagian besar buru, sementara sebagian masuk ke mata air bawah tanah.
claims.quote: The burus were ostensibly eliminated when the Apatani people drained the wetlands to facilitate rice cultivation. Most of the burus died because of the drainage, and many supposedly went underground into the springs.

claims.statement: Hatsadiling is a mythical bird commonly found in Northern Thai art.
claims.statement_id: Hatsadiling adalah burung mitos yang umum muncul dalam seni Thailand utara.
claims.quote: Hatsadiling (Thai: หัสดีลิงค์; Burmese: ဟတ္ထီလိင်္ဂ; Pali: hatthīliṅga; Sanskrit: hastilinga) is a mythical bird commonly featured in Northern Thai art. The creature is considered to be the size of a house, with the head and body of a lion, trunk and tusks of an elephant, the comb of a cock, and the wings of a bird.

claims.statement: Its form combines a lion, an elephant's trunk and tusks, a cock's comb and bird wings.
claims.statement_id: Rupanya memadukan singa, belalai dan gading gajah, jengger ayam, serta sayap burung.
claims.quote: The creature is considered to be the size of a house, with the head and body of a lion, trunk and tusks of an elephant, the comb of a cock, and the wings of a bird.

claims.statement: Northeastern Thai oral tradition places this bird in Himavanta forest.
claims.statement_id: Tradisi lisan Thailand timur laut menempatkan burung ini di hutan Himavanta.
claims.quote: According to an oral myth in northeastern Thailand, the bird once inhabited the legendary forest of Himavanta.

claims.statement: Its motif appears on funerary hearses for prominent monks in cremation ceremonies.
claims.statement_id: Motifnya digunakan pada kereta jenazah biksu terkemuka dalam upacara kremasi.
claims.quote: The bird is often featured as a motif on funerary hearses of prominent Buddhist monks in Northern Thailand during phongyibyan cremation ceremonies.

claims.statement: The Camadevivamsa features the bird in the account of Hariphunchai's founding.
claims.statement_id: Camadevivamsa menyebut burung tersebut dalam kisah pendirian kerajaan Hariphunchai.
claims.quote: The bird was considered instrumental in the founding of Hariphunchai, a Mon kingdom in modern-day Thailand. It is featured in Cāmadevivaṃsa, a Pali chronicle that recounts the founding of the Hariphunchai kingdom by Queen Camadevi. The Dhammapada-aṭṭhakathā mentions the hastilinga. Buddhaghoṣa mentions it as an animal which possesses the strength of five elephants.

claims.statement: Buddhaghosa describes it as possessing the strength of five elephants.
claims.statement_id: Buddhaghosa menyebutnya memiliki kekuatan lima gajah.
claims.quote: Buddhaghoṣa mentions it as an animal which possesses the strength of five elephants.

claims.statement: Ichchhadhari Nag are shapeshifting cobras of Indian folklore and mythology.
claims.statement_id: Ichchhadhari Nag adalah ular kobra pengubah wujud dalam cerita rakyat dan mitologi India.
claims.quote: ಇಚ್ಛಧಾರಿ ನಾಗ್ (ಸ್ತ್ರೀಲಿಂಗ: ಇಚ್ಛಧಾರಿ ನಾಗಿನ್) ಭಾರತೀಯ ಜಾನಪದ ಮತ್ತು ಪೌರಾಣಿಕೆ ಕಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ  ಆಕಾರವನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುವ ನಾಗರಹಾವುಗಳಾಗಿವೆ. ಇವುಗಳು ಹಾವಿನಿಂದ ಮನುಷ್ಯರೂಪಕ್ಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮನುಷ್ಯರೂಪದಿಂದ ಪುನಃ ಹಾವಾಗುವ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಹೊಂದಿವೆ ಎಂಬ ಕಥೆಗಳಿವೆ. ಅವರು ಶಿವನ ಮಹಾನ್ ಭಕ್ತರಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

claims.statement: In stories they can change between serpent and human form.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita, mereka dapat berubah antara bentuk ular dan manusia.
claims.quote: ಇಚ್ಛಧಾರಿ ನಾಗ್ (ಸ್ತ್ರೀಲಿಂಗ: ಇಚ್ಛಧಾರಿ ನಾಗಿನ್) ಭಾರತೀಯ ಜಾನಪದ ಮತ್ತು ಪೌರಾಣಿಕೆ ಕಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ  ಆಕಾರವನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುವ ನಾಗರಹಾವುಗಳಾಗಿವೆ. ಇವುಗಳು ಹಾವಿನಿಂದ ಮನುಷ್ಯರೂಪಕ್ಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮನುಷ್ಯರೂಪದಿಂದ ಪುನಃ ಹಾವಾಗುವ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಹೊಂದಿವೆ ಎಂಬ ಕಥೆಗಳಿವೆ. ಅವರು ಶಿವನ ಮಹಾನ್ ಭಕ್ತರಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

claims.statement: They are believed to gain human form after Shiva's blessing.
claims.statement_id: Mereka dipercaya memperoleh wujud manusia setelah mendapat berkat Shiva.
claims.quote: ಕತೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿರುವಂತೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಗಂಡು ನಾಗರಹಾವು ಇಚ್ಚಾಧಾರಿ ನಾಗ (ಗಂಡು ಆಕಾರವನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುವ ನಾಗರಹಾವು) ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಹೆಣ್ಣು ನಾಗರಹಾವು ೧೦೦ ವರ್ಷಗಳ ತಪಸ್ಸಿನ ನಂತರ ಇಚ್ಚಾಧಾರಿ ನಾಗಿನ್ (ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಆಕಾರವನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿದ ನಾಗರಹಾವು ಆಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಶಿವನಿಂದ ಆಶೀರ್ವದಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ನಂತರ ಅವರು ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ಮಾನವ ರೂಪವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಇವು ಯಾವುದೇ ಜೀವಿಯ ಆಕಾರವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದುವ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.

claims.statement: Stories connect them with a Nagamani jewel guarded against thieves.
claims.statement_id: Cerita menghubungkan mereka dengan permata Nagamani yang dijaga dari pencuri.
claims.quote: ಇಚ್ಛಧಾರಿ ನಾಗಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನಾಗಿಣಿಯರು ನಾಗಮಣಿ ಎಂಬ ಆಭರಣವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಇವು ಯಾವುದೇ ಅಮೂಲ್ಯವಾದ ಕಲ್ಲುಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಮೌಲ್ಯಯುತವಾಗಿದೆ. ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಅದು ತನ್ನ ಮಾಲೀಕರನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಬದುಕಿಸುವ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಾರವಾದ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ  ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಈ ನಾಗಮಣಿಯನ್ನು ಕದಿಯಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿದಾಗ ಆ ಜನರು ಹಾವು ಕಡಿತದಿಂದ ಸಾಯುತ್ತಾರೆ ಎಂದು ದಂತಕಥೆಗಳು ಹೇಳುತ್ತವೆ.

Depicted as a black dog, it assists Erlang Shen in battle by using its powerful bite and howl to attack, maul, or subdue demons.

claims.statement: It helps Erlang Shen fight demons through its bite and howl.
claims.statement_id: Ia membantu Erlang Shen melawan iblis melalui gigitan dan lolongannya.

claims.statement: Some identify it with Tiangou.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian orang mengidentifikasinya dengan Tiangou.
claims.quote: Many identify Xiaotian Quan with the mythological Tiangou. Consequently, the cultural idiom describing a solar eclipse as the 'heavenly dog eating the sun' is often interpreted as an allusion to Xiaotian Quan.

claims.statement: It is also identified with Hou Yi's hunting hound.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga diidentifikasi dengan anjing pemburu Hou Yi.
claims.quote: The dog is also identified with the hunting hound of the legendary archer Hou Yi.

claims.statement: In Journey to the West it helps fight Sun Wukong.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Journey to the West ia membantu melawan Sun Wukong.
claims.quote: In the novel Journey to the West, Xiaotian Quan helps fight Sun Wukong and later the Nine-Headed Prince Consort (九頭駙馬).

claims.statement_id: Kepercayaan lain menganggapnya tahap perkembangan jiangshi, mayat hidup.

claims.statement: Some legends describe the Hou as doglike and feeding on dragon brains.
